title: Guatemala: Memory of Silence (Tz'inil Na'tab'al) - Report of the Commission for Historical Clarification
publisher_or_archive: United Nations / Historical Clarification Commission, Guatemala
summary: Official United Nations-sponsored truth commission report investigating the 36-year armed conflict precipitated by the 1954 CIA coup, documenting over 200,000 deaths and disappearances (93% perpetrated by US-trained military and security forces) and concluding that state forces committed acts of genocide against the indigenous Maya population.
